note: Machine-readable form of the approved curation decisions. Every rule carries the decision it implements and the reason it exists, so a reader of datasets/manifest.json can trace any excluded image back to a human decision. Rules exclude images from SPLITS; they never modify or delete anything under datasets/raw/.
min_test_rule_note: Acceptance gate: every class needs >=50 test images. Where 15% falls short, the TEST FRACTION for that class is raised (capped at max_test_fraction) rather than the gate being lowered. This is ADR-021 decision 7 generalised: fix the allocation, never the bar. Classes that still cannot reach 50 are reported as gate failures, not silently accepted.

dataset_role_reasons.plantdoc: ADR-021 decision 5. Held out entirely as the field-realism benchmark and NEVER trained on. Its own train/test split is discarded, which dissolves the 11 duplicate groups and 8 label contradictions that crossed it rather than patching them.

excluded_groups.reason: Publisher-derived augmentations of the original split. 1,398 duplicate clusters were measured spanning the boundary; they must never reach val/test.

Publisher states these are derived from the raw images. The audit detected ZERO duplicate clusters spanning the boundary — a demonstration of the rotation/mirror blind spot, NOT evidence of independence. Exclusion is enforced by construction, never by trusting a dedup result.

excluded_classes.reason: 116 post-dedup images, below the pre-registered 150 floor. Excluded rather than shipping a class that fails a criterion we set before seeing the data. Largely genetic/physiological, so farmer impact is minimal and the abstain path covers the residue. Images retained in raw for a later revisit.

PlantVillage's Background_without_leaves is Western stock/tourist photography (streets, boats, churches, a parrot). It would teach 'not-a-leaf = European holiday photo' while failing to reject soil, hands, walls or fruit, and its 1,135 trivially separable images would inflate accuracy for no product benefit. Non-crop rejection is handled by the confidence/abstain path.

duplicate_collapse.representative: lexicographically smallest path in the cluster (deterministic)
duplicate_collapse.reason: Near-duplicate clusters collapse to a single image everywhere, so the manifest counts unique information rather than files. Keeping copies would silently up-weight whichever dataset happens to be most redundant (rice_odisha is 59% redundant; plantvillage is 0.07%) and would let a test set score the same photograph several times. This is what makes the approved 'rice = 2,446 usable' figure true of the splits and not just of a report.

unmapped_class_policy.reason: A raw class directory with no entry in the audit's CLASS_MAP has no agreed meaning in our label space (other crops in PlantVillage/PlantDoc; the DIU 'Rice' whole-plant category). Excluded and counted, never guessed into a code.

quarantine.stock_provenance_reason: ADR-021 decision 5, as approved: quarantine only images whose stock/watermark origin is objectively evidenced. A filename carrying a stock agency's name and asset ID is objective, checkable evidence. Quarantined images are excluded from the evaluation set and recorded with their reason; the raw files are untouched.
quarantine.stock_provenance_limitation: NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. Filename matching cannot see a watermark burned into pixels whose filename is neutral, and the audit found such cases visually (Getty/Alamy/Shutterstock marks, plus a screenshot of a web factsheet and a photograph of chopped herbs). Those require the human review queue this script emits. Absence of a filename match is not evidence that an image is clean.

label_contradiction_rule.reason: ADR-021 decision 5. A file the publisher filed under two different diseases cannot serve as ground truth for either. Every copy is quarantined, not just one side.

manual_quarantine_note: Images excluded after direct visual inspection, where no objective rule could catch them (pixel-burned watermarks with neutral filenames, screenshots, non-leaf subjects). Each entry names its reviewer and reason and points at an exact path, so any entry can be checked or reversed. Content judgements only — no agronomic relabelling.

source_stratified_splits.reason: The confound probe measured that source datasets are separable from background alone (chilli 0.91, rice 0.96, tomato 0.96). A split that happened to align with source would let a model score by recognising capture style rather than disease. Each (class, source) stratum is therefore split independently, so every split carries the same source mix.

known_confounds.evidence: datasets/confound-report.json — chilli_primary vs chilli_secondary separable at 0.91 accuracy from a single background statistic (a lower bound; a model does better). CHILLI_ANTHRACNOSE exists ONLY in chilli_secondary; CHILLI_BACTERIAL_SPOT, CHILLI_NUTRIENT_DEFICIENCY and CHILLI_POWDERY_MILDEW exist ONLY in chilli_primary. Those three class pairs are decidable by capture style alone.
mitigations_applied: source-stratified splits (no split aligns with source)
per-class source composition recorded in the manifest
chilli held at GENERAL tier — no field-robustness claim
known_confounds.evaluation_gate: Metrics for CHILLI_ANTHRACNOSE, CHILLI_BACTERIAL_SPOT, CHILLI_NUTRIENT_DEFICIENCY and CHILLI_POWDERY_MILDEW MUST be reported with this confound stated, and MUST NOT be presented as evidence of disease-discrimination ability. The Grad-CAM background-reliance probe in docs/ml/error-analysis.md is REQUIRED for chilli before any chilli accuracy figure is published.
known_confounds.residual_risk: Not removed, only contained. The only complete fix is chilli imagery of the same classes from a second capture style — no such data exists in the corpus.
known_confounds.open_option_requiring_approval: Excluding CHILLI_ANTHRACNOSE (323 unique images, the sole chilli_secondary-only class) would remove all three source-disjoint pairs outright. It costs a real disease class, so it is a product decision and is NOT applied here.

known_confounds.evidence: datasets/confound-report.json — rice_healthy_diu vs rice_odisha separable at 0.96. RICE_NORMAL comes only from the studio source; RICE_BROWN_SPOT only from the field source. Healthy-vs-brown-spot is therefore decidable by background alone.
mitigations_applied: per-class source composition recorded in the manifest
known_confounds.evaluation_gate: The RICE_NORMAL <-> RICE_BROWN_SPOT confusion cell MUST be reported explicitly in the evaluation battery, not folded into macro-F1 alone. RICE_NORMAL recall MUST NOT be quoted as field performance. If RICE_NORMAL recall exceeds RICE_BROWN_SPOT recall by a wide margin, treat it as evidence of the shortcut, not of skill.
known_confounds.residual_risk: Cannot be removed with the data on hand: no field-realistic healthy rice imagery exists in the corpus. The complete fix is field-realistic healthy rice data used FOR TRAINING, which ADR-021 decision 2 (option c) reserves for separate approval.
known_confounds.open_option_requiring_approval: Acquire a field-realistic healthy rice dataset for TRAINING (not evaluation-only). This is the only measure that removes the confound rather than containing it.

pre_training_checks_required.reason: CHILLI_HEALTHY and CHILLI_CERCOSPORA_LEAF_SPOT draw from both chilli sources while ANTHRACNOSE comes only from the paper-background set and POWDERY_MILDEW / NUTRIENT_DEFICIENCY / BACTERIAL_SPOT only from the cut-out set. Both sources are studio imagery separable by capture style, so a model can score well by reading the background. The merged chilli label space must not be trusted until a probe shows source is not trivially predictable.
pre_training_checks_required.blocking: chilli claims only, not the training run

pre_training_checks_required.reason: RICE_NORMAL is 100% studio imagery (582 images, leaves on white paper); no field-realistic healthy rice exists in the corpus. Healthy-rice field performance is UNVALIDATED and must not be claimed. Any field-realistic healthy rice data obtained later is EVALUATION-ONLY unless separately approved for training.

COTTON.note: 6 classes. Ships only once each has a KB entry (en+hi) and the agronomist items (a)-(c) are signed off.

CHILLI.note: Trainable, but no field-robustness claim: both sources are studio imagery and no field-realistic chilli evaluation set exists yet.

RICE.note: Healthy-rice field-condition performance is unvalidated. Do not claim field robustness for healthy-rice classification.
